summary:
# Certified outward facet angles of a verified sweep

Incremental commit `933b58cd1a378fda5a1cd89eb080fa319e7f658a` follows the closed sweep mesh and the committed open-grid facet cone. The geometry work is confined to new sweep-face-normal files. The shape remains a single original sweep.

The two outward layers use the original unit normal with the sign of their displacement boundary. On a wall, with free source-axis derivative indexed by f, the oriented normal is the normalized cross product `(S_f+tN_f)×N`. The proof evaluates its equivalent expression `(S_f×n)/|n| + t(n_f×n)/|n|²` with directed rational intervals on an original UV collar and an exact displacement interval. Applying the analytic face winding produces a directed outward normal box. The actual rounded facet vertices determine an exact facet normal. Strict positive dot products and acute-cone inequalities at each normal-box corner cover the entire continuous source cell.

An angle request refines displacement as well as U and V. Each cell can use either diagonal, preserving the shared stations. The full closed embedding and positive volume checks still run after the angular proof.

| Control | Requested angle (rad) | Triangles | Proved deviation (rad) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Bivariate roof with varying wall normals, original and signed-rotated placements | 0.2 | 192 | 0.045137341 |
| Same two placements | 0.03 | 768 | 0.022550169 |
| Planar slab with exact nonbinary displacement | 0.00000001 | 12 | 0 |

An independent analytic evaluator checks every signed face at each cell's parameter corners and displacement midpoint. Thin wall boxes at displacements 0 and 1/10 have disjoint second-coordinate intervals. The qualified negative-orientation sweep preserves the correct outward lower and upper layer signs. Any unproved angle or one-short work budget returns no shell.

Six complete default/omitted-angle result and option hashes reproduced byte-for-byte for the slab and both original curved fixtures at two distance requests. Full mesh and CSG offset tests, focused geometry and race tests, and vet passed.

Evidence is in `sweep-facet-final-native.log`, `sweep-facet-final-race.jsonl`, `sweep-facet-face-normals.log`, and `sweep-facet-zero-{baseline,current}.tsv`.
